item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description:
Today, let's talk Mindset.
You started grounded — good sleep, water first thing. The day carries a clear thread: catching negative patterns before they run, checking whether you're mind-reading instead of listening, and asking if each moment fits the life you're building. That's the real work today, not the tasks around it.
Action: before you react to anything today, pause and ask if you're projecting.
